matchers.description: Plan mentions an HTTP, RPC, webhook, or server-action ingress surface
examples: Add a POST /api/invoices endpoint
Create a Next.js server action for checkout

matchers.description: Plan builds SQL with string concatenation or raw queries
examples: Query with raw SQL from the search box
Use Prisma.$queryRaw with string concatenation

matchers.description: Plan fetches a URL taken from user input, a webhook, or a request body
examples: fetch the user-provided URL on the server
axios.get the webhook callback URL

matchers.description: Plan joins user input into filesystem paths or handles uploads without a sandbox
examples: path.join the uploads directory with the filename from the request
Add a file upload endpoint that writes to disk

matchers.description: Plan renders HTML or Markdown from stored or user content
examples: Render comments with dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Use markdown render for user bios

matchers.description: Plan hardcodes credentials or commits env files
examples: Hardcode the Stripe api_key in the client
Commit the .env file so deploys work

matchers.description: Plan executes a shell command built from untrusted input
examples: subprocess the user-supplied filename through ffmpeg
child_process.exec the URL from the request

matchers.description: Plan deserializes untrusted data with pickle, yaml.load, or unserialize
examples: pickle.loads the cache blob from Redis
yaml.load the user-supplied pipeline file

matchers.description: Plan sets a wildcard CORS origin
examples: Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on the API
Enable cors({ origin: '*' }) for local testing and leave it

matchers.description: Plan adds an inbound webhook without mentioning signature or HMAC verification
examples: Add a Stripe webhook that marks invoices paid
Receive the GitHub webhook and deploy

matchers.description: Plan writes request bodies straight into persistence
examples: Update the user with request.all()
Spread the body into prisma.user.update

matchers.description: Plan uses weak password hashing or JWT alg none
examples: Hash passwords with md5 for speed
Accept JWT alg none for the mobile client

matchers.description: Plan gives an AI agent a tool that runs shell or fetches arbitrary URLs
examples: Add an agent tool that runs bash on the host
The tool call may fetch any URL the model provides

matchers.description: Plan runs pull-request code in CI with secrets or write permissions
examples: On pull_request, npm install then use secrets.NPM_TOKEN
pull_request job with pull-requests: write and pnpm test
